effect.name: GM Time Slice
effect.desc: Cuts the layer into bands and gives each band its own moment. Six constructions: Slit Scan slides every band sideways by a progressively larger amount, Repeat Tile replaces each band's slice coordinate with its own so the picture tiles along the axis, Mirror Echo reflects it about the band centre for a kaleidoscopic echo, Radial Slices does the same thing in polar coordinates, Stretch Bands scales each band around its own centre, and Freeze Column makes every band take its content from the first. Band count, offset, an accumulation curve, stagger, edge feather, direction, animation, in-band blur and clamp/mirror/wrap sampling are all separate.
